citation: [1905 S. Prairie Ave. (Marshall Field residence).] Photograph of the house from the west side of the avenue; unknown photographer, undated (file '923prairiefieldhome', the pre-1880 number). Reproduced on chicagology.com, Prairie Avenue, 1905 S. Prairie.
author: unknown photographer
date: undated (file name uses the pre-1880 number)
repository: chicagology.com (secondary reproduction; the original holder is not named). Prairie library image a19-cgy-1905-field-923 (stream-1900.json). The image store's copy is committed since T-3271 at data/sources/assets/field_1905_pictures_t3271/field_923_prairie_photo.jpg with its attribution, as the owner directed on 2026-10-11 for the image gate's pictures.
locator: A cast-iron gas lamp in front of the house's north part, on the parkway beside the walk, in front of the scroll-pattern iron fence. For the image gate (T-3271): the whole print, the street front from its north end to the canted south-west corner, the corner, the south flank with its first window column, the glass conservatory and the dining room's columns behind it, the mansard with dormers and cresting, the stone basement and the scroll fence.
rights_note: A secondary web reproduction whose original source and rights are not stated (the Prairie library's ruling: 'unknown - link only'). Only what stands in the street and where is read from it; nothing is derived from the image as an asset.
